svg.title: Prepare reaction-aliquot NMR sample
svg.desc: Prepare reaction-aliquot NMR sample. Combine the withdrawn 200 µL reaction aliquot with 300 µL dichloromethane-d2 and 100 µL of the 22.4 mM dimethyl terephthalate stock in dichloromethane-d2. These are three physical inputs; the bulk reaction is not added again. Source-bound conceptual stage; no measured vessel dimensions, liquid level, molecular geometry or particle shape is implied.

foreignObject.div: 200 µL aliquot withdrawn from reaction mixture, Dichloromethane-d2, 22.4 mM dimethyl terephthalate in dichloromethane-d2
Physical NMR mixture of reaction aliquot, diluent and standard stock

standard stock aliquot: 100 µL
air unless individually stated otherwise
